$comment: Single source of truth for scope -> stage routing, iteration bounds and failure categories.
Read by scripts/lib/pipeline-config.mjs; every consumer (scripts/run-pipeline.mjs, the
workflow skills, the docs) must derive its routing from this file rather than restating it.
scripts/test/pipeline-config.test.mjs fails the build when a copy drifts.
stages[].kind is the TARGET classification from docs/architecture.md (llm | tool | gate).
stages[].prompt is how the stage is implemented TODAY. A stage with kind 'tool' that still
carries only a prompt is one the migration has not mechanized yet -- see roadmap.md.
Ported 1:1 from the SUBCHAINS constant that used to live in scripts/run-pipeline.mjs and
from the scope descriptions in schemas/revision.schema.json. Semantics were not changed.

orchestrator.description: scope the change; open/route the revision

skillValidator.description: validate the skill pack against the target API

visualAnalyzer.description: ratios, anchors, regions from the reference

architectureMapper.description: map regions to primitives + theme tokens

exact-diff.summary: Binary pixel diff against the parent revision.
exact-diff.rule: magick compare -metric AE == 0 on every page; the metric is quoted verbatim in visual-review, never paraphrased.

region-diff.summary: Region-aware pixel diff against the parent revision.
region-diff.rule: magick compare -metric AE on the affected regions (per changed-components); every region outside that list must be byte-equal to the parent (AE == 0).

visual-review.summary: Layer-by-layer review against the reference image.
visual-review.rule: Per docs/visual-accuracy-contract.md; APPROVE only when every mismatch is at most MINOR or ACCEPTED_LIMITATION.

skillValidation.summary: Skill validation is enforced on EVERY scope, including the scopes whose chain has no skillValidator stage.
skillValidation.onHalt: the render process exits with status 4 (the halt contract in prompts/skill-validator-agent.md)

new.description: First revision of a project (revision-001, or parentRevisionId null). Runs the full chain.

visual-change.description: The render must look different from the parent (new layout, swapped fonts, new icon set, restyled section). Compared against the reference image.

refactor-only.description: The render must look IDENTICAL to the parent (class rename, helper extraction, data-spec split, dependency upgrade, package move).

data-only.description: A field inside <doc-kind>-data.json changed (email, phone, heading, list item). Java, assets and theme unchanged.

asset-only.description: An entry inside asset-request.json changed (icon set swap, font family swap). Java, data and theme unchanged.

theme-only.description: A token inside the theme bundle changed (palette colour, type scale, decoration glyph, spacing token). Cross-cutting visual effect, so reviewed against the reference rather than diffed against the parent.
